spots.title: Upper arm
spots.why: The lake narrows toward the incoming river or creek; moving water carries food.

walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.bait: jig and minnow, slow, near bottom

perch.bait: small jig with a minnow head on the bottom

spots.title: Steep ledge
spots.why: A sharp wall beside deep water; fish hang along the edge at the depth they like.
